items.title: Constellation Energy (CEG) Launched Peak+ Nuclear And Storage Contracts
items.summary: Constellation Energy (NasdaqGS: CEG) has introduced Peak+ contracts that bundle nuclear power, battery storage, and demand response into one package. The Peak+ structure targets long term supply deals for large buyers that want cleaner power with more flexible delivery profiles. items.summary: Constellation Energy reported Q3 2026 sales of US$9.55b and net income of US$1.84b, with basic EPS from continuing operations of US$5.19. The company also raised full year guidance while affirming its quarterly dividend. The business has secured long dated nuclear power agreements with customers like Amazon and Google.
